title: Sonnet passes and adjudicator against the reference and the Opus passes
question: Is Sonnet 5.5 closer than Haiku 5.5 to the Opus passes and the reference, as annotator and as adjudicator?
method: The S0 comparison instrument on the stored Sonnet sets, against the root's reference and passes A and B; undecided value pairs decided by the root in manual_equivalence.tsv.
commands: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/reference results/s0/stored/pass_sg ref_vs_sg
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/reference results/s0/stored/pass_sp ref_vs_sp
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/stored/pass_sg results/s0/stored/pass_sp sg_vs_sp --symmetric
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/stored/pass_a results/s0/stored/pass_sg a_vs_sg --symmetric
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/stored/pass_b results/s0/stored/pass_sg b_vs_sg --symmetric
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/reference results/s0/stored/adjudication_d7_s ref_vs_d7s --symmetric
conclusion: Sonnet matches Opus on what is claimed (core 0.91-0.92 against the reference, A 0.93) but not on qualifiers (full 0.42-0.54 against 0.80); Sonnet against an Opus pass (0.48-0.54 full) is close to Opus against Opus (0.63) and to Sonnet against Sonnet (0.67), so most of the full-tier gap is conventions the inputs do not state; with the pages Sonnet agrees better on qualifiers (0.54 against 0.42 packet-only, intervals overlapping). As adjudicator Sonnet reaches core 0.97 and full 0.82, against Haiku's 0.74.
